cases.description: 2^60, a double beyond 2^53, written as YAML parses back to the same double rather than to an error.
2^60 written as JSON parses back to the same double rather than to an error.
2^60 as a front-matter field of a Markdown record parses back to the same double rather than to an error.
The nearest double of 1e23, an integer-valued double beyond 2^53 that is not exactly 10^23, round-trips through YAML.
